A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Circuit Compositions study. All 22 pages of each version, including Appendices A–E, provide readable text, equations, tables, and figures. Relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v2 reports original PCFG SET model and circuit experiments measuring accuracy, faithfulness, sparsity, and overlap, plus TRACR validation and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds empirical results for a sparsity-regularization sensitivity analysis in Appendix D.1.3 and Table 6.

M1.justification: The activation-pruning objective, deterministic mask approximation, neuron-level interventions, ablation procedures, and circuit-union construction remain unchanged. The new regularization sweep evaluates the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ten PCFG SET string-edit operations and four TRACR validation tasks. The added sensitivity analysis uses the existing copy and repeat tasks without extending dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Full-model references, constituent-circuit comparisons, and TRACR validation remain unchanged. The newly cited Yu et al. and Chen et al. works are not evaluated as competing methods.

E3.justification: Appendix D.1.3 adds a sweep over five reported lambda values, from 10^-2 to 10^-6, for copy and repeat. Existing splits, metrics, model configurations, and Table 5 hyperparameters are retained. The main-text random-search statement repeats information already in v2 Appendix C.5.1.

E4.justification: The new lambda sensitivity analysis tests the faithfulness–sparsity tradeoff on two retained tasks. Existing seed-stability, mean-versus-zero ablation, sparsity, and circuit-composition analyses remain present; their renumbering does not represent additional analyses.

E5.justification: The five-seed prepend experiment reporting IoU and IoM of 1.0 moves from Appendix D.1.3 to D.1.4 without substantive revision. No new run-count disclosures, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests accompany the added sensitivity results.

E6.justification: New Table 6 reports faithfulness, KL divergence, and sparsity across the lambda sweep. For copy, lambda=10^-2 gives faithfulness 0.228 and retained-node fraction 0.022; lambda=10^-6 gives 0.999 and 0.298. These are added results under different settings; existing matched results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11, optimization objectives, faithfulness and overlap definitions, and set-operation mathematics are retained. Added intuitive explanations introduce no new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about circuit discovery, shared structure among functionally related circuits, and functional capabilities obtained through circuit unions.

C2.justification: Section 4.3.3 adds a tentative explanation that circuit unions shift activation representations toward another task's feature space. Section 7 additionally defends the controlled PCFG SET setting and asserts applicability to other models and tasks, while retaining the existing completeness and generalization limitations.

D1.justification: v2 promises code release upon acceptance; v3 declares the code publicly available and supplies a repository location in Section 4 and Appendix A. The sensitivity sweep also documents its lambda values. Existing hardware, computational budgets, implementation details, and selected hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Yu et al. (2024) and Chen et al. (2025) to the completeness discussion and references. Research positioning otherwise remains stable. Syed et al.'s update from a 2023 preprint to its 2024 publication represents the same cited work.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording edits, expands explanations of overlap metrics, adds cross-references, standardizes appendix-heading capitalization, and shortens acknowledgments. The overall narrative and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Table 6, reorders module columns in Figures 5, 20, and 21 while preserving their values, and expands Figure 5's caption. Existing tables and figures also shift with text reflow, without a substantial redesign.

improvement.justification: Table 6 makes the method's dependence on regularization directly assessable, addressing an empirical gap in v2, while the concrete code location improves reproducibility documentation. These are limited gains with stable central findings. The new mechanism explanation remains tentative, and the sensitivity paragraph mistakenly says six values although it lists and reports five.
